prometheus: These commands assume the Helm release is named prometheus in the monitoring namespace.
After install: forward the Prometheus server port to your machine and open http://localhost:9090.
export POD_NAME=$(kubectl get pods --namespace monitoring -l "app.kubernetes.io/name=prometheus,app.kubernetes.io/instance=prometheus" -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}")
argo-cd: These commands assume the Helm release is named argo-cd in the argocd namespace.
After install: forward the Argo CD HTTPS Service and open https://localhost:8080.
Run this in another terminal to retrieve the generated password for the admin account. Never commit real secrets to Git.
